steps.name: Install production Python 3.14 and pinned test tools
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv -r requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.17.2

steps.name: Serve the site under gunicorn and fetch public pages
argv: .venv/bin/gunicorn --bind 127.0.0.1:3002 --workers 1 app:app & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid' EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3002/ && break; sleep 1; done; for path in / /es/ /llms.txt; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3002$path); echo "$path $code"; test "$code" = 200; done
